turns.text: Hi Siobhán, hi Declan, thanks for the time. The goal today is to close out the commercial questions so legal can start on the MSA.
Sounds good. Before we get into it, I want to explain why I'm being so careful about the rollout plan.
Please, go ahead.
We ran Veritrack for a year at the Cork site. Implementation took nine months, not the four they sold us, and we pulled out.
That's painful. What went wrong, if you don't mind me asking?
Their supplier module never worked with our ERP, and every change request was a paid project. By month six the plant had gone back to spreadsheets.
And the audits didn't get any easier in the meantime.
No. Chevonne's team did the audit prep last time, two and a half weeks, mostly chasing supplier certs.
Which is exactly the module you'd start with. Siobhán, does the timeline still work for you?
We need to be live before the March audit. That's the hard date for me.
Understood. We'd plan the supplier hub first and CAPA second, and we'd commit to a go-live date in the order form.
We don't need the supplier portal module, by the way, our suppliers won't log into another portal. Just the certificate tracking.
That's fine, that also brings the price down a bit.
Good. On hosting, our board is strict. If you ever lost EU hosting, we'd walk.
Everything runs in Frankfurt, and it's in the contract.
Then I'm comfortable. It's my budget and my sign-off, so you don't need to go further up.
That's clear, thank you. What do you need from us to get the paperwork moving?
Send the redlined MSA to our legal team. I'll sign once legal clears the MSA, target Friday the thirteenth of November.
I'll send the redlines to your legal team tomorrow morning.
And I'll book the kickoff with my team for the week after signature.
Perfect. Thanks both, this has been really helpful.
